svg.title: Dependence rises with value and falls with availability; divided among many parties it loses its restraining force
svg.desc: Left panel: contours of dependence D = v divided by lambda in the plane of motivational investment v (horizontal) and availability of alternatives lambda (vertical); dependence is high where v is high and lambda low. Right panel: the private cost of a degrading action borne by one of M synthetic parties is gamma over M; it falls below the private benefit b once M exceeds gamma over b, after which the action is individually rational though collectively destructive.
